name: Degla Inc
long_description:
Degla AI builds autonomy software that enables drones to understand spoken instructions, reason onboard, and adapt as the mission unfolds. Once you’ve expressed your intent, the system owns the problem.

An operator can say, “Find the missing hiker wearing a red sweater.” The drone plans the mission, interprets what it sees, and adjusts its flight as new information emerges. The operator sets the objective and the aircraft handles the execution.

At the core is an onboard vision-language model that interprets what the drone sees, understands the operator’s intent, and guides mission planning, execution, and adaptation. Running locally on NVIDIA Jetson, it makes mission decisions without relying on cloud inference.
one_liner: The fully autonomous intelligence layer in the sky.
